title: Grateful Dead Live at Cumberland County Civic Center on 1982-09-17
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi DR-8 > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab > CD-Wave > R8Brain > TLH > FLAC 2496
source: 3x Nakamichi CM300's > Nakamichi 550 > Maxell XLII-S. Set up in the row of tapers directly behind the soundboard

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 9/17/82 Portland show with blistering Jerry solos and a classic Bertha opener, captured in an okay‑quality tape.
ai_review.review: Fans rave that this September 1982 Portland concert is one of the best they’ve heard – a “cookin’ Bertha” opener, a scorching Jerry solo on Morning Dew, sweet playing on Deal, and a monster The Other One → Sugar Magnolia finish. Recording quality is described only as “okay,” with no major flaws noted, making the performance the main draw.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews award 5 stars and praise the musical performance heavily; recording quality is only mildly critiqued, so the combined rating stays very high.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers say the audio is “okay” with no specific issues mentioned; no detailed comments on clarity or mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong opener with Bertha and a high‑energy close featuring The Other One into Sugar Magnolia; overall pacing praised.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple mentions of blistering, first‑class solos (Morning Dew, Deal) and overall top‑notch playing all night.
band_member_comments.Bob: Noted that Bob Weir (Bobby) pulled his A‑game alongside Jerry on vocals.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland did not sing this night; no further keyboard comments.
